description: Starter retrieval corpus authored from the golden QA set. Two query tiers over the same documents: 'lexical' queries share vocabulary with the answer sentence, 'semantic' queries are natural paraphrases that mostly avoid it. Each query has exactly one relevant document. Swap this file for a domain corpus (documents + queries with relevant_ids and optional tier) to evaluate real retrieval.

documents.text: Paris is the capital city of France, located in the north of the country.
The arithmetic expression 2 + 2 evaluates to 4.
Python is the programming language whose interpreter uses the Global Interpreter Lock, known as the GIL.
The Hermes Agent was developed by the company Nous Research.
The first version of the Python programming language was released in the year 1991.
SQL stands for Structured Query Language, used to manage relational databases.
The primary function of a regression test is to verify that recent changes have not broken existing functionality.
In the context of web requests, latency is the time it takes for a request to travel from the client to the server and for the response to return.
Big O notation is used for describing the limiting behavior of a function when the argument tends towards a particular value or infinity, and it is often used to analyze algorithmic complexity.
In JavaScript, a closure works as a function bundled together with references to its surrounding state, known as the lexical environment.
The four pillars of object-oriented programming are encapsulation, abstraction, inheritance, and polymorphism.
A process is an independent execution unit with its own memory space, while a thread is a lightweight unit within a process that shares its memory.
Polymorphism is the ability of different classes to respond to the same method call in their own specific way.
Abstraction is the process of hiding complex implementation details and showing only the necessary features of an object.
A REST API, or Representational State Transfer API, is an architectural style for providing standards between computer systems on the web.
GraphQL is a query language for APIs and a runtime for fulfilling those queries with your existing data.
Garbage collection works as a form of automatic memory management that identifies and frees memory no longer in use by the program.
Recursion is a method of solving a problem where the solution depends on solutions to smaller instances of the same problem.
The purpose of hashing is to map data of arbitrary size to fixed-size values, typically for efficient data retrieval or security.
A deadlock is a situation where two or more processes are unable to proceed because each is waiting for the other to release a resource.
Dependency injection is a design pattern where an object receives other objects that it depends on, rather than creating them internally.
Continuous integration is the practice of merging all developers' working copies to a shared mainline several times a day.
Unit testing is the process of testing the smallest testable parts of an application in isolation.
An asynchronous function in Python is a function defined with async def that can be paused and resumed, allowing for concurrent execution using an event loop.
Memory leakage is a situation where a program incorrectly manages memory allocations such that memory which is no longer needed is not released.
A blockchain is a distributed, decentralized ledger that records transactions across many computers.
A microservice architecture is an architectural style that structures an application as a collection of small, autonomous services modeled around a business domain.
Cloud computing is the on-demand delivery of IT resources over the internet with pay-as-you-go pricing.
Containerization means packaging software code together with all its components like libraries, frameworks and other dependencies so that it can run uniformly and consistently on any infrastructure.
Artificial intelligence is the simulation of human intelligence processes by computer systems.
Machine learning is a subset of artificial intelligence that involves training algorithms to learn from and make predictions based on data.
Natural language processing is a field of AI that gives machines the ability to read, understand, and derive meaning from human languages.
An IDE, or Integrated Development Environment, is a software application that provides comprehensive facilities for software development.
Version control systems record changes to a file or set of files over time so that you can recall specific versions later.
The role of a compiler is to translate source code written in a high-level programming language into machine code that a computer's processor can execute.
A database is an organized collection of structured information, or data, typically stored electronically in a computer system.
SQL, or Structured Query Language, is the standard language for managing and manipulating relational databases.
NoSQL is a category of database management systems that do not use the traditional relational table-based structure.
A pointer is a variable whose value is the memory address of another variable.
An algorithm is a step-by-step procedure or formula for solving a problem.
Object-oriented programming is a programming paradigm based on the concept of objects, which can contain data and code.
Functional programming is a programming paradigm where programs are constructed by applying and composing functions.
The purpose of a firewall is to monitor and control incoming and outgoing network traffic based on predetermined security rules.
Encryption is the process of encoding information or messages in such a way that unauthorized parties cannot read it.
A cookie is a small piece of data stored on the user's computer by the web browser while browsing a website.
A session is a mechanism for maintaining state between a client and a server over a series of requests.
DNS, the Domain Name System, is the hierarchical and decentralized naming system for computers, services, or other resources connected to the Internet.
HTTPS, or Hypertext Transfer Protocol Secure, is an extension of HTTP for secure communication over a computer network.
JSON, or JavaScript Object Notation, is a lightweight format for storing and transporting data.
XML, or Extensible Markup Language, is a markup language that defines a set of rules for encoding documents in a format that is both human-readable and machine-readable.
